source_findings.snapshot_wait: server.rs:build_replica_until marks preparation reader reservation/capacity waits as parallel_snapshot_wait. Mutex admission is separately tagged fifo_wait.
source_findings.current_bound: Entity SnapshotPinState requires reader_handles+reserved_reader_handles<56 and total handles+reserved<64. Writer reserve8; contract-generated64 physical bound, fixed160MiB transaction byte quota.
source_findings.no_duplicate_pin_shortcut: Entity replica transactions already lease the replica root pin instead of registering another. Removing a supposed second pin is not applicable.
source_findings.prior_gap: Existing pin_capacity_resource_contract_gap_20261008 already records non-scaling bounds; previous256 counterfactual was rejected. Current evidence confirms wait attribution rather than reopening that constant experiment.

limitations: Observers perturb execution; sampled stage and client timings have no default-off acceptance credit.
Wait sums overlap across requests; stage totals are not additive wall time.
turn.event.record combines streamed and terminal events; no precise stream-versus-settle decomposition.
Admission and post-running-restart metrics are separate native epochs; do not add them.
Sparse sampling does not prove maximum active pin occupancy or memory pressure history.
No scheduling/capacity/cache policy changed or admitted; original1s goal not achieved.
next_measurement: Determine how long prepared commands retain reader pins while waiting for commit admission, preserving FIFO, ownership, OCC, GC, deadlines and writer headroom.
